The '''Verpine prototype ion blaster''' was an [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blaster]] created by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] to specifically annihilate [[Droid/Legends|droid]] enemies. The sheer amount of droids destroyed during the demonstration of this weapon increased the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] uneasiness towards Verpine testing practices.
